audience: HR and payroll teams that run German payroll in Paychex Europe Payroll

useCases.title: Find an employee and read the personal record
useCases.text: List the companies your key may read, then search the employees of one company by name. Open a record to read its personal and contact data.

useCases.title: Check the contract of an employee for one month
useCases.text: Read the contract of an employee for one month: start and end dates, employment type and occupation.

useCases.title: Review the salary of an employee for one month
useCases.text: Read the salary of an employee for one month, with gross salary and hourly rate. List the salary components that make up the pay.

useCases.title: List the absences of an employee
useCases.text: List the leave, sickness and maternity absences of an employee, one page at a time. Open the employee record for the same person.

useCases.title: Read the company data before a payroll check
useCases.text: Read the legal and address data of a company. Then list its employees, with an optional name search.
